label: import_docs setting (Sync Gateway)
type: the per-database boolean enabling Sync Gateway's import of Couchbase-Server-side document mutations. Must be true on both clusters for xdcr:active-active-with-app-services. Operator discipline (not a platform-enforced limit) is the only guard against running import on more than one Sync Gateway node in a cluster.
note: Second instance in this batch of the same 'hazard managed by prose discouragement, not an enforced guardrail' pattern also seen on sgw:index-partitioning's partitioning settings.
